_meta.name: correlation_inference
_meta.description: Per-pair p-values and confidence intervals on correlation matrices (params.inference) over training_data.pulse: the Pearson matrix of price, income and label with auxiliary.p and 95% Fisher-z intervals (auxiliary.ci_lower / ci_upper; each pair on its own rows under pairwise deletion), and the partial correlation of price and income holding label fixed with 90% intervals (params.alpha 0.1, df = N* - 2 - 1). The diagonal and any pair too thin for its figure are null (PULSE_MATRIX_INSUFFICIENT_N, scope inference). Nothing corrects for the many pairs. The auxiliaries ride matrices[*].auxiliary: a return preset standard drops them.
